case_number: 2024 INSC 698; WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 265 OF 2022, 250 OF 2022
summary: Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 Section 6 sanction requirement; Central Government rejected sanction for prosecution of army personnel in Nagaland incident; interim order staying proceedings made absolute; FIR quashed due to missing mandatory sanction; conditional observation that if sanction granted in future via parallel writ, proceedings may resume; rejection of State of Nagaland's attempt to bypass sanction bar; departmental actions permissible despite criminal proceedings barred.
final_judgment: Writ petitions allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; interim order made absolute; proceedings to resume only if future sanction granted under AFSPA.
